browser_checks.name: inert construction, explicit intent, shared ownership and teardown
selection replaces baseline, missing/empty data, obsolete callbacks and lossless integers
receipt/acquisition/sample deadlines, delayed timers and reconnect invalidation
runtime and resource freshness stay distinct from process/sample data
inactive model status requires a current observation connection
listener isolation and synchronous transport lifecycle changes
SSE routing, native/closed retries, malformed JSON and cancelled callbacks
multiplexed channels, per-topic ages, filtered views and reconnect baseline
HTTP explicit requests, CSRF, mount boundary and command uncertainty without replay
HTTP cancellation before dispatch, in flight, timeout and disposal
real EventSource/fetch loads selected packaged modules and releases demand
transient media renewal retries the same subscription without dropping its transport
unconfirmed media renewal stops at its deadline including browser suspension
media authorization and source rejections disconnect immediately
obsolete media renewal completion cannot change a new connection
overlay switching revokes video without restarting the detector owner
explicit video reconnect awaits a fresh binding even when hidden-tab polling paused
selected restart requires confirmed cleanup and never continues after uncertainty or cancellation
independent source selectors keep requested and resolved configurations separate
AV packets sample the device without animation frames; timeout and focus still pause
AV controller rendering is deferred, skips unchanged DOM, and releases pending paint
AV receipt and video views preserve unchanged text and immediately reflect pause

limitations: Browser renewal errors and clock suspension are injected fixtures; they do not reproduce radio interference.
Initial browser fixture omitted a signalling URL; its failure was retained and the corrected fixture rerun.
